image_description: A dark blue and white minibus parked on a gravel surface. The vehicle features a boxy shape, a large front windshield, side windows, and visible text/logos on the side and front. A portion of another blue vehicle is visible in the bottom right foreground.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic compact, high-roof profile of a minibus (likely a Suzuki Carry or similar microbus derivative). It is clearly shorter than a standard city bus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large, single-pane windshield is visible. Side windows are present along the passenger cabin, though partially obscured by reflections and the angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The roofline is high relative to the width. A sliding door track/handle mechanism is visible on the side, indicating a mid-body entrance typical of this class.
The vertical seam and handle placement on the side panel strongly suggest a sliding door mechanism, consistent with minibus design.
The short hood/nose section ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout (or semi-bonneted), which is standard for this type of minibus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is completely outside the frame; only the front three-quarters are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a two-tone blue and white livery with visible text/logos ('go...'), fitting the description of company/route markings.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel is small diameter (approx 13-14 inch) with a simple steel rim and hubcap, typical for commercial vans/minibuses.
The overall dimensions and window configuration align with a vehicle capacity of roughly 8-12 passengers, fitting the 'minibus' definition.

artifact_observations.location: Side panel text and front license plate
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the side door appears to spell 'go...' but dissolves into nonsensical characters towards the rear. The front license plate contains alphanumeric strings that look plausible at a glance but lack sharp, distinct character definitions upon close inspection, showing slight melting/blurring typical of AI text generation.

Reflections in the windshield are somewhat smeared and lack the crisp linear highlights expected from real glass. The interior details visible through the side windows are muddy and indistinct, lacking clear seat structures.
The gap between the headlight assembly and the black bumper trim is inconsistent and slightly blurred, suggesting minor geometric imprecision in the model's rendering of tight tolerances.
